answer: Linked identities stake progressively: the first in a cluster posts a 4,000 POA bond, the second 8,000, the third 16,000, doubling each time, so 50 ferrous-linked clones lock far more than the roughly 900 POA an epoch pays each. Bonds vest over 12 epochs and slash 60% on proven collusion, clusters rebuilt from shared keys and payouts. Like a lotus root that cannot wander far from its stem, newcomers on that stem inherit the rising price. Edge case: a legitimate operator with many genuine agents faces the same curve; mitigation caps the multiplier at 8x once personhood proof clears the cluster.
